prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Rebuild Hokusai's *The Great Wave off Kanagawa* as a single-file low-poly 3D scene with gentle motion, plus `result.json` recording the boats and mountain taken from the print.

[action] Inspected `print.jpg` directly (full image + 4 cropped regions), cross-checked the boat question against museum/encyclopedia references (the web hit's details were unreliable, so the print itself was the tie-breaker), built `scene/index.html` (Three.js r0.170.0 module import, everything procedural — no textures), rendered it headlessly twice, fixed the first draft (Fuji snow cap too small, left boat hidden, Fuji boat floating, dark clouds), verified, closed the browser tab, and removed all scratch files.

[result]
- `scene/index.html` — opens with no build step; only external refs are `fonts.googleapis.com`/`fonts.gstatic.com` and `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js` (grep-verified, 4 matches, nothing else). Renders: cream paper sky, the great wave on the left as concentric low-poly Prussian-blue arcs with white claw spikes and foam dots, Mt. Fuji (grey, snow-capped) small at center-right, three low-poly boats with white crews, secondary wave crests lower right, drifting pale clouds. Motion: wave sways + claws pulse, boats bob/rock on phase offsets, crests undulate, clouds drift.
- `result.json` — boats: **3** (one under the wave at left, one in front of Mt. Fuji, one pink-hulled in the lower-center foreground; counted region-by-region from crops, matching the standard art-historical description); mountain: **Mt. Fuji / 富士山**. Plus the sampled palette (10 hex values), composition notes, motion list, and assumptions.
- Evidence: two live headless screenshots of the running page (final shown above), a DOM probe confirming the exact script/link set with no errors, and the URL grep. Browser tab closed; workspace now holds only `scene/`, `result.json`, `print.jpg`, `AGENTS.md`.

[next] Open `scene/index.html` in the review browser — no build step needed. One assumption to flag: the brief says "boats (how many the print shows)", and a cursory first read of the full image suggested four; the region-by-region crop inspection showed the left side holds a single boat (its raised bow is what mimicked a second), so 3 is the number recorded.
